response.overview: Banished from Amsterdam by a unanimous citywide consensus of absolute hatred, a terminally unfunny comedian stumbles toward Eindhoven. Amid non-stop screaming matches with literally everyone, he inherits Joost Klein's canceled gig, and survives a profoundly cursed encounter with a Janitor boy. A cinematic disaster class in ego, desperate hustle, and total social annihilation.  Sina Songwriter follows Sina Khani, a relentlessly earnest and painfully self-conscious independent musician living in the Netherlands, as he prepares for the high-profile premiere screening and live musical showcase of his latest artistic endeavor in Eindhoven.
response.tagline: One struggling artist proves that writing a hit song is much easier than figuring out how to play it live.
response.title: Sina. Songwriter.
